items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: my good friend and partner Bruce Barth, we met around that time and started jamming together... we’ve been working together now for like fourteen years

ctx.x: The Village Gate had some stuff going. Then they had another club uptown near Columbia University that also had some sessions, and of course my good friend and partner Bruce Barth, we met around that time and started jamming together at his house. And his wife was kind enough to let us all come over a couple of times a week and play. And we’ve been working together now for like fourteen years as a result of that. So yeah it happened in a variety of clubs.

That tradition of kind of getting into jam sessions and hopefully proving yourself has been around for a long time. In the late eighties was the repertoire that you’re expected to know, was it still the standards?
